A best-effort OpenAPI 3.1 description of selected endpoints from the Apache
NiFi REST API. NiFi exposes a comprehensive JWT-authenticated REST API for
managing processors, connections, controller services, process groups,
reporting tasks, provenance, flow versions, system diagnostics, access
control, parameter contexts, and data transfer. The canonical machine
readable specification is published by the NiFi project as
`/nifi-docs/swagger.yaml`.
